g.text: The CorpusReader contract and its implementors
Both required methods borrow &self and return a
may be iterated more than once and moved across
threads. No shipped reader overrides estimated_tokens,
there is no gzip / xz / zstd support.
create_corpus_reader(path, CorpusFormat) in the CLI returns
Box<dyn CorpusReader>, so the reader is chosen at run time
— the format is never sniffed from content.
